mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees with clear skies at Verona City Hall, a full moon is out, and if you are a night owl, you can see the International Space Station at 3:25 AM as it travels from over Mount Horeb toward the Home Depot in Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is excited to highlight the new tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center, allowing residents to enjoy nature on the Military Ridge State Trail, plus Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as National Senior Center Month.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with Yoga today at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia also happening today, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a report from August 17, Verona Police officers located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough and our local Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM to serve it up.
